title: Appending a captured bit
statement: For every Boolean word $w$ and bit $b$, the captured clock tape of $w$ followed by $b$ is obtained from the captured clock tape of $w$ by updating the cell at integer coordinate $|w|+1$ to the tagged bit $b$.
replaced:
For every bit word $w$ and every bit $b$, the captured clock tape of $w$ extended by
$b$ differs from the captured tape of $w$ in exactly one cell: the cell at coordinate
$|w| + 1$, which becomes the bit symbol of $b$.
